title: Start a class session from the list

steps.say: **Play as class** at the end of a row starts a shared practice session without opening the class first.
Your device leads and the whole class moves together, from wherever the class last got to in its own course.
It is the same session the class page starts, so it moves the class on for everyone on the roster. Only school staff see this button, and only on a live account.
steps.terminal: That's starting a session from the list — find the class, tap, teach. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
